findings:
🔵 [k3-semver-build-meta] CUT/FOLLOW-UP scripts/lib/semver.js rejects `1.2.3+build` (fixture matrix.json "malformed" list). Strict SemVer §11 treats build metadata as ignored-for-precedence but still parseable. The plan's accepted grammar is `X.Y.Z(-(alpha|beta|rc).N)?` with no build-metadata clause, every consumer (sync-version, preflight, check-optin-changelog, session-start) only ever sees registry versions, and the probe-unknown golden + semver.test.sh both pass the matrix as-is. Adding a `+<build>` arm would widen the grammar beyond what any release script needs and would require re-pinning the matrix; defer unless a consumer actually needs it.
🔵 [k3-backlog-Fix-suffix] CUT/FOLLOW-UP check-backlog-entries.js rejects `Fix!`/`H急` (parseEffortValue returns null; badEffortDetail names the valid sizes) while migrate-backlog-entries.js mapEffort correctly maps them to `S!`. No current backlog row carries a suffixed legacy value (all migrated sidecars are bare `Fix`/`H`), so this cannot fail today; if a future author writes `Fix!` the checker refuses it with a correct "valid: XS|S|M|L|XL with optional !" message and the migration still repairs it. Tightening the checker to recognise legacy+suffixed forms is optional hardening.
